key_decisions.rationale: Keeps contrasting movement and named place within bracketed passage.
key_decisions.before: Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
key_decisions.after: while Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves trap, accusation purpose, embodied delay, writing, and variant-marked inattention phrase.
key_decisions.before: They said this to test him so they would have grounds to accuse him. But Jesus bent down and wrote on the ground with his finger.
key_decisions.after: They said this to test him, so that they would have grounds to accuse him. But Jesus bent down and wrote on the ground with his finger, appearing not to notice them.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But they were saying this, testing him, so that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus, bending down, was writing with his finger on the ground.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps persistence, sin qualification, first-stone responsibility, and targeted woman.
key_decisions.before: When they kept asking him, he stood up and said, “Let the one among you who is without sin be the first to throw a stone at her.”
key_decisions.after: When they kept questioning him, he straightened up and told them, “Let the one among you who is without sin be the first to throw a stone at her.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But when they persisted in asking him, he straightened up and said to them, “The one among you without sin—let him be the first to cast a stone at her.”

key_decisions.rationale: Closes double-bracketed passage and keeps noncondemnation with ethical command.
key_decisions.before: She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go, and from now on do not sin anymore.”
key_decisions.after: She answered, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go, and from now on do not keep sinning.”⟧
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And she said, “No one, Lord.” And Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you; go, and from now on sin no more.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves plural sins, egō eimi without supplied predicate, and repeated warning.
key_decisions.before: That is why I told you that you will die in your sins. Unless you trust that I am, you will die in your sins.”
key_decisions.after: That is why I told you that you will die in your sins. Unless you believe that I am, you will die in your sins.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore I said to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am, you will die in your sins.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps crucifixion-exaltation, egō eimi, dependence, and teaching.

key_decisions.after: So Jesus said, “When you lift up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am, and that I do nothing on my own but speak these things just as the Father taught me.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps charge directed at present opponents, devil, murder, truth, lying, and paternity without racial generalization.
key_decisions.before: You are from your father, the devil, and you want to carry out your father’s desires. He was a murderer from the beginning and did not stand in the truth because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks from his own nature, because he is a liar and the father of lies.
key_decisions.after: You are from your father the devil, and you want to carry out your father’s desires. He was a murderer from the beginning and did not stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks from his own nature, because he is a liar and the father of lies.

That one was a murderer from the beginning and does not stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him.
